purpose: Go + Gin + SQLite template for web AI document pipelines; sprouts customize prompts, LLM JSON shape, and static UI.

skills.when: First orientation — where to start, key files, gotchas
Add a field to the LLM output struct + prompt + UI in sync
Replace DocumentAnalysis with a domain-specific struct end-to-end
Colors, copy, layout widths, result modal renderer
Support a new MIME / file format in the upload pipeline
Add a SQLite table, query helpers, optional API endpoint
Add a new HTTP API endpoint
Add a tab to the admin panel
Add a config field to the Jump-Start wizard
Upload a file via curl and check pipeline result end-to-end
Trace errors from logs to exact Go/static files

customization_surfaces.role: Primary business logic as plain text; loaded at startup into pipeline.

DocumentAnalysis (default) or domain structs. json + description tags feed llm.BuildSchema → Gemini structured output. Implement LLMOutput interface (SchemaName() string). Register via pipe.Routes in cmd/server/main.go.
pipe.Routes maps MIME types to output structs and optional custom Process functions. First matching Route wins; nil Matches = catch-all.
Landing upload UX and modal rendering of JSON result (renderAnalysis ~line 161).
Admin tabs; extend only if new admin APIs exist.
Schema + migrations (append-only, CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS). Query helpers as methods on *DB.
One Converter per MIME family. Register in init() in converter.go. Add MIME to allowedMIMETypes in internal/handlers/files.go.

notes: CGO_ENABLED=1 required (sqlite3 + go-fitz). Makefile sets it.
Struct fields + prompts must stay in sync — Gemini sees both.
Adding a struct field without updating renderAnalysis in analyze.js means data is never shown.
Go module path in go.mod must be updated alongside all import paths if the app is renamed.
